en: A vintage, sepia-toned postcard view of a European city along a river, with a bridge crossing the water in the foreground and rows of buildings on both banks. In the background a steep hill rises, topped by fortification walls and buildings, with a prominent clock tower on the right side of the hill. A church tower with a bulbous dome stands among the city buildings. Printed text at the top left reads "Graz mit Schloßberg."
